note: Written before further paper data is collected. Do not change after the bot restarts; a change starts a new experiment.
pass_rule: closed trades >= min_closed_trades AND 95% bootstrap CI of mean net P&L per trade lies entirely above 0
fail_rule: equity <= stop_equity OR (closed trades >= min_closed_trades AND CI entirely below 0)
otherwise: INSUFFICIENT: not enough trades to say anything
live_money_bar: PASS on paper, then explicit user approval and a Danish legal/tax check; paper fills are optimistic, real results would be worse
